title: Plexiglass and Civility: The Vice-Presidential Debate

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访几位在商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 扎伊兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经修饰的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: With the vice presidential debates just days away, all eyes are on the number twos.
sentences.zh: 随着副总统辩论仅剩几天时间，所有的目光都聚焦在二号人物身上。

sentences.en: After a chaotic presidential debate last week.
sentences.zh: 在上周那场混乱的总统辩论之后。

sentences.en: Mike Pence and Kamala Harris are set to face off in what is being considered one of the most important VP debates in history.
sentences.zh: 迈克·彭斯和卡玛拉·哈里斯即将在被认为是历史上最重要的副总统辩论之一中展开对决。

sentences.en: And the president's hospitalization with the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 还有总统感染新冠病毒住院的消息。

sentences.en: President Trump's illness is a stark reminder of the stakes for the debate.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统的病情严峻地提醒着人们这场辩论的利害关系。

sentences.en: They would be second in line behind men who are in their 70s.
sentences.zh: 他们将是继两位70多岁的老人之后的第二顺位继承人。

sentences.en: The vice presidential nominees faced off on Wednesday night in Salt Lake City.
sentences.zh: 副总统候选人于周三晚在盐湖城进行了辩论。

sentences.en: The important question is going to be, who do you trust to take over the presidency?
sentences.zh: 重要的问题是，你信任谁来接管总统职位？

sentences.en: Should one of these people at the top of the ticket be unable to do it?
sentences.zh: 如果竞选搭档中的首位人选无法履行职责该怎么办？

sentences.en: And I just can't think...
sentences.zh: 我简直无法想象……

sentences.en: We watch, as usual, with national political correspondent Alex Burns.
sentences.zh: 我们照常与国家政治记者亚历克斯·伯恩斯一起观看。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, October 8th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月8日，星期四。

sentences.en: Alex, good morning.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，早上好。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: That was a regular, old debate.
sentences.zh: 那是一场规规矩矩的传统辩论。

sentences.en: And therefore, it was very refreshing.
sentences.zh: 因此，这让人感到非常耳目一新。

sentences.en: It really was.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It was much more of an actual exchange of views and an actual clash over records than we got from the presidential debate last week.
sentences.zh: 与我们上周看到的总统辩论相比，这更像是一场真正的观点交流和政绩交锋。

sentences.en: It was much more normal as just a viewing experience, as a political experience.
sentences.zh: 无论从观看体验还是政治体验来看，它都正常得多。

sentences.en: And I think it's not going too far to say that it's probably more useful to the average voter rather than the kind of just barroom fight that we had last week.
sentences.zh: 我认为说它对普通选民更有用并不为过，而不是像我们上周看到的那种酒吧斗殴。

sentences.en: Right, and less emotionally traumatic.
sentences.zh: 没错，而且没那么让人情绪崩溃。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You know, we had a lively debate on our team about whether we were going to cover the vice presidential debate.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们团队曾就是否要报道这场副总统辩论进行过激烈的讨论。

sentences.en: Vice presidential debates are always a little bit up in the air in terms of their importance and their influence.
sentences.zh: 副总统辩论在重要性和影响力方面一直有些悬而未决。

sentences.en: But then events changed how we were thinking about it because they seemed to very much change the stakes of a vice presidential debate.
sentences.zh: 但随后发生的事件改变了我们的想法，因为它们似乎极大地改变了副总统辩论的利害关系。

sentences.en: They really did.
sentences.zh: 确实改变了。

sentences.en: I mean, if you ever needed a reminder about the stakes of choosing a number two in a world where, no matter who the next president is,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果你还需要提醒在这样一个世界里选择二号人物的重要性，无论下一任总统是谁，

sentences.en: it's going to be a guy over 70 and perhaps quite close to 80.
sentences.zh: 他都将是一位70多岁甚至接近80岁的人。

sentences.en: We really got that over the last week with President Trump's infection with the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 过去一周特朗普总统感染新冠病毒的事件确实给了我们这种提醒。

sentences.en: So what exactly were the stakes going into this?
sentences.zh: 那么，这场辩论的利害关系究竟是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, last week, you told us that the presidential debate was about Donald Trump needing to change the subject away from the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，上周你告诉我们，总统辩论的重点是唐纳德·特朗普需要转移人们对疫情的关注。

sentences.en: This was before, as you said, he tested positive for COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 这是在他如你所说新冠检测呈阳性之前。

sentences.en: And it was about Biden trying to seal the deal, given his lead in the polls.
sentences.zh: 而对拜登来说，这是为了利用他在民调中的领先优势锁定胜局。

sentences.en: What was this debate, the vice presidential debate, about?
sentences.zh: 那么这场副总统辩论的重点是什么？

sentences.en: You know, clearly there was no way tonight that Mike Pence was going to be able to change the subject from the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很明显今晚迈克·彭斯无论如何也无法将话题从新冠病毒上转移开。

sentences.en: Just the last week has made that totally impossible for Republicans.
sentences.zh: 仅仅过去的一周就让共和党人彻底无法做到这一点。

sentences.en: So I think the task for him was, can you stabilize the Republican ticket in an atmosphere of really extreme chaos on the Republican side,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他的任务是，在共和党内部极度混乱的氛围中，能否稳定住共和党的竞选阵营，

sentences.en: where you have the president ill, hospitalized, out of the hospital, blowing up COVID relief talks, popping off about different potential medical treatments?
sentences.zh: 总统生病、住院、出院、叫停新冠救助谈判、对各种潜在医疗方案信口开河？

sentences.en: This is not a recipe for success for the party.
sentences.zh: 这绝不是该党走向成功的秘诀。

sentences.en: So can Pence deliver a different kind of message trajectory for the party for the close of this campaign?
sentences.zh: 那么彭斯能否为该党在竞选最后阶段带来一种不同的信息轨迹？

sentences.en: And what about Kamala Harris?
sentences.zh: 那卡玛拉·哈里斯呢？

sentences.en: You know, I think for Senator Harris, it was a somewhat different task.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为对于哈里斯参议员来说，任务有所不同。

sentences.en: I think unlike Joe Biden, she's not really in a position to close the deal overall with the American electorate.
sentences.zh: 我认为与乔·拜登不同，她并没有真正处于能够全面锁定美国选民支持的地位。

sentences.en: She's not the top of the ticket, even though at some point the expectation is that she probably might be.
sentences.zh: 她不是竞选搭档中的首位人选，尽管人们预期在某个时候她可能会是。

sentences.en: So for her, it's can you really hold the course?
sentences.zh: 所以对她来说，问题在于能否稳住阵脚？

sentences.en: Can you keep the focus on the administration and its failures on the pandemic and not give any ground on the stuff where you know Mike Pence is going to come after you?
sentences.zh: 能否继续关注政府在疫情应对上的失败，并且在你知道迈克·彭斯会攻击你的问题上不退让半步？

sentences.en: So it's a little bit boring to put the challenge for her in these terMs.
sentences.zh: 用这些词来描述对她的挑战可能有点无聊。

sentences.en: But just can you hold steady in a race where you're already winning?
sentences.zh: 但简单来说，就是在你已经领先的竞选中能否保持稳定？

sentences.en: Good evening.
sentences.zh: 晚上好。

sentences.en: From the University of Utah in Salt Lake City, welcome to the first and only vice presidential debate of 2020.
sentences.zh: 从盐湖城的犹他大学，欢迎收看2020年唯一一场副总统辩论。

sentences.en: So let's talk about what happened as the debate gets underway.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们谈谈辩论开始时发生了什么。

sentences.en: Please welcome California Senator Kamala Harris and Vice President Mike Pence.
sentences.zh: 请欢迎加州参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯和副总统迈克·彭斯。

sentences.en: So you have the candidates take the stage on what was a pretty typical debate set with the exception of two big plexiglass reminders of the events of the last few days in the White House and the president's health.
sentences.zh: 候选人们登上了舞台，这是一个相当典型的辩论场景，除了两个巨大的有机玻璃隔板，它们提醒着人们过去几天白宫发生的事件以及总统的健康状况。

sentences.en: These are shields that are set up on either side of the two candidates in order ostensibly to protect them from infecting each other,
sentences.zh: 这些防护罩设置在两位候选人两侧，表面上是为了保护他们免受彼此感染，

sentences.en: although there's some question as to whether because of the nature of how the virus is transmitted, they would serve anything like that purpose.
sentences.zh: 尽管有人质疑，鉴于病毒传播的特性，它们是否能起到那样的作用。

sentences.en: The two campaigns in the Commission on Presidential Debates have agreed to the ground rules for tonight.
sentences.zh: 两个竞选团队和总统辩论委员会已经就今晚的规则达成了一致。

sentences.en: I'm here to enforce them.
sentences.zh: 我在这里负责执行这些规则。

sentences.en: The moderator, Susan Page, sets up the event and makes it quite clear from the outset that they plan to have a different kind of event than the debate last week.
sentences.zh: 主持人苏珊·佩奇主持了这场活动，并从一开始就明确表示，他们计划举办一场与上周辩论不同类型的活动。

sentences.en: We want a debate that is lively, but Americans also deserve a discussion that is civil.
sentences.zh: 我们希望进行一场生动的辩论，但美国人民也理应看到一场文明的讨论。

sentences.en: So Page says there are going to be nine themes and she starts with the obvious one, the big one.
sentences.zh: 所以佩奇说将有九个主题，她从最显而易见、最重要的那个开始。

sentences.en: Senator Harris, the coronavirus is not under control.
sentences.zh: 哈里斯参议员，新冠病毒尚未得到控制。

sentences.en: What would a Biden administration do in January and February that a Trump administration wouldn't do?
sentences.zh: 拜登政府在1月和2月会采取什么特朗普政府不会采取的措施？

sentences.en: Would you impose new lockdowns for businesses and schools and hotspots?
sentences.zh: 你会对企业、学校和疫情热点地区实施新的封锁吗？

sentences.en: A federal mandate to wear masks?
sentences.zh: 会强制在全国范围内佩戴口罩吗？

sentences.en: You have two minutes to respond without interruption.
sentences.zh: 你有两分钟时间回答，期间不得被打断。

sentences.en: Thank you, Susan.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，苏珊。

sentences.en: This is the moment, I think,
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是那一刻，

sentences.en: the lead-off question where Senator Harris probably got as close as she did throughout the night to that moment that a lot of Democrats were clearly hoping for.
sentences.zh: 在开场问题上，哈里斯参议员可能整晚最接近许多民主党人所期待的那一刻。

sentences.en: Well, the American people have witnessed what is the greatest failure of any presidential administration in the history of our country.
sentences.zh: 嗯，美国人民已经目睹了我国历史上任何一届总统政府最大的失败。

sentences.en: She really aggressively prosecuted the case about the administration's failings on the pandemic in a blunt, memorable way.
sentences.zh: 她以一种直率、令人难忘的方式，非常有力地控诉了政府在疫情应对上的失职。

sentences.en: And here are the facts.
sentences.zh: 事实如下。

sentences.en: 210,000 dead people in our country in just the last several months.
sentences.zh: 在过去几个月里，我国有21万人死亡。

sentences.en: Over 7 million people who have contracted this disease.
sentences.zh: 超过700万人感染了这种疾病。

sentences.en: One in five businesses closed.
sentences.zh: 五分之一的企业倒闭。

sentences.en: And here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 重点在于。

sentences.en: On January 28th, the vice president and the president were informed about the nature of this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 1月28日，副总统和总统就获悉了这场疫情的性质。

sentences.en: They were informed that it's lethal in consequence, that it is airborne, that it will affect young people.
sentences.zh: 他们被告知其后果是致命的，它是通过空气传播的，而且会影响年轻人。

sentences.en: And they knew what was happening and they didn't tell you.
sentences.zh: 他们知道正在发生什么，但他们没有告诉你。

sentences.en: I think that set the table for the rest of the debate in an important way because it set Pence on the defensive.
sentences.zh: 我认为这为辩论的其余部分奠定了重要的基调，因为它让彭斯处于守势。

sentences.en: Before, there were more than five cases in the United States, all people who had returned from China.
sentences.zh: 在那之前，美国只有不到五例病例，且都是从中国返回的人员。

sentences.en: President Donald Trump did what no other American president had ever done.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统做了其他美国总统从未做过的事情。

sentences.en: And that was he suspended all travel from China, the second largest economy.
sentences.zh: 那就是他暂停了所有来自第二大经济体中国的旅行。

sentences.en: He was awfully selective in his defense of the administration's record and how it has handled the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 他在为政府的记录及其处理疫情的方式辩护时，非常有选择性。

sentences.en: With that time, we were able to reinvent testing.
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里，我们得以重塑检测能力。

sentences.en: More than 115 million tests have been done to date.
sentences.zh: 迄今为止已经进行了超过1.15亿次检测。

sentences.en: From the start, it's pretty clear that Mike Pence is going to try not to address head on just how dire the condition in the country is.
sentences.zh: 从一开始就很清楚，迈克·彭斯试图不正面回应这个国家的情况有多么严峻。

sentences.en: Alex, Pence did something quite interesting in his defense of the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，彭斯在为特朗普政府辩护时做了一件非常有趣的事情。

sentences.en: He turned to Kamala Harris and said...
sentences.zh: 他转向卡玛拉·哈里斯说……

sentences.en: The difference here is President Trump and I trust the American people to make choices in the best interest of their health.
sentences.zh: 这里的区别在于，特朗普总统和我信任美国人民，相信他们会做出符合自身健康利益的选择。

sentences.en: You don't trust Americans when it comes to their public health in this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 在这场疫情中，你并不信任美国人民的公共卫生选择。

sentences.en: We trust Americans.
sentences.zh: 我们信任美国人。

sentences.en: Joe Biden and Kamala Harris consistently talk about mandates, and not just mandates with the coronavirus, but a government takeover of health care, the Green New Deal,
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登和卡玛拉·哈里斯不断谈论强制令，不仅是针对新冠病毒的强制令，还有政府接管医疗保健、绿色新政，

sentences.en: all government control.
sentences.zh: 一切都是政府控制。

sentences.en: We're about freedom and respecting the freedom of the American people.
sentences.zh: 我们主张自由，尊重美国人民的自由。

sentences.en: This is a line of attack that I think in a lot of situations Republicans have found successful for them.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是共和党人在许多情况下发现行之有效的攻击路线。

sentences.en: It's a cousin of, you know, the line that you often hear from Republicans about taxes, that we should cut taxes because you can spend your money better than the government can.
sentences.zh: 这和你经常从共和党人那里听到的关于税收的论调如出一辙，即我们应该减税，因为你比政府更会花钱。

sentences.en: Just this distrust of government.
sentences.zh: 就是这种对政府的不信任。

sentences.en: From all the public opinion research that we have done at the Times and that we've seen in this campaign,
sentences.zh: 根据我们在《时报》所做的所有民意调查以及我们在这次竞选中所看到的，

sentences.en: it's actually not a winning hand on the coronavirus, that the American electorate does want to see government take bigger steps.
sentences.zh: 这在新冠病毒问题上实际上并不是一张好牌，美国选民确实希望看到政府采取更大的行动。

sentences.en: And in a situation where the majority of the country thinks that the federal government and president have mishandled the pandemic,
sentences.zh: 而在全国大多数人认为联邦政府和总统处理疫情不当的情况下，

sentences.en: I just don't know that it scans for voters to claim that criticizing the government is actually criticizing the American people.
sentences.zh: 我不知道声称批评政府实际上就是批评美国人民这种说法对选民来说是否站得住脚。

sentences.en: Let's talk about respecting the American people.
sentences.zh: 让我们谈谈尊重美国人民。

sentences.en: You respect the American people when you tell them the truth.
sentences.zh: 当你对美国人民说实话时，你才是尊重他们。

sentences.en: Alex, were you surprised in this moment or anywhere in the debate that Harris didn't use this as an opportunity to talk about President Trump contracting the virus,
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，你是否对哈里斯在这一刻或辩论中的任何时候没有利用这个机会谈论特朗普总统感染病毒感到惊讶，

sentences.en: to accuse him of being reckless and endangering other people's health at that White House event or at the rallies he's held,
sentences.zh: 没有指责他在那场白宫活动或他举行的集会上鲁莽行事并危及他人的健康，

sentences.en: or to talk about the way in which he has, since he was infected, downplayed the danger of the virus?
sentences.zh: 或者没有谈论他在感染后淡化病毒危险性的方式？

sentences.en: That never came up at all from Kamala Harris.
sentences.zh: 卡玛拉·哈里斯根本没有提到这些。

sentences.en: It didn't.
sentences.zh: 确实没有。

sentences.en: And it's definitely a pretty notable omission.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是一个相当明显的遗漏。

sentences.en: I think there's a lot of sensitivity on the Democratic side about not wanting to do or say anything that might be seen as a low blow against an ailing president.
sentences.zh: 我认为民主党方面非常敏感，不想做或说任何可能被视为对生病的总统进行人身攻击的事情。

sentences.en: I do think that there probably would have been ways to make the point about the irresponsibility of the White House,
sentences.zh: 我确实认为可能有一些方法可以指出白宫的不负责任，

sentences.en: holding these maskless rallies, these big gatherings, where people are clearly not following public health guidance,
sentences.zh: 举行这些不戴口罩的集会，这些大型聚会，人们显然没有遵循公共卫生指导，

sentences.en: without making it sound like, you know, the president got what he had coming to him.
sentences.zh: 而不会让人听起来像是总统自作自受。

sentences.en: But I do think that is the implication that Democrats were concerned about, that there are a lot of ways to make the case that the president has mishandled the coronavirus
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为这是民主党人所担心的暗示，即有很多方法可以证明总统处理新冠疫情不当，

sentences.en: without getting potentially into the territory where you seem to be taking advantage of the president being sick.
sentences.zh: 而不会陷入那种看起来像是利用总统生病进行攻击的境地。

sentences.en: So then we get to an exchange about the economy, and I want to talk about what happened there, because it was a very interesting set of exchanges.
sentences.zh: 接下来我们谈到了关于经济的交流，我想谈谈那里发生了什么，因为那是一系列非常有趣的交流。

sentences.en: But America, you just heard Senator Harris tell you, on day one, Joe Biden's going to raise your taxes.
sentences.zh: 但是美国人民，你们刚刚听到哈里斯参议员告诉你们，上任第一天，乔·拜登就会给你们加税。

sentences.en: It's really remarkable to think, Susan.
sentences.zh: 苏珊，这真是太引人注目了。

sentences.en: I mean, right after a time where we're going through a pandemic that lost 22 million jobs at the height,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在经历了疫情导致高峰期失业2200万人的时期之后，

sentences.en: we've already added back 11.6 million jobs because we had a president who cut taxes, rolled back regulations.
sentences.zh: 我们已经增加了1160万个就业岗位，因为我们有一位减税、放松监管的总统。

sentences.en: This is where it gets a little more directly contentious between the two of them, where you start to see Vice President Pence try to be more on the offensive, more assertive.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们两人之间争论变得更加直接的地方，你开始看到副总统彭斯试图采取更具进攻性、更自信的态度。

sentences.en: And if the entire COVID section is really about the vice president struggling to defend a record that is widely regarded as a failure for this administration,
sentences.zh: 如果整个新冠部分真的是关于副总统努力为一项被广泛认为是本届政府失败的记录进行辩护，

sentences.en: the economy is really the one remaining point of relative strength for the president and the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 那么经济确实是总统和共和党仅存的相对优势点。

sentences.en: We literally have spared no expense to help the American people and the American worker through this.
sentences.zh: 我们确实不惜一切代价帮助美国人民和美国工人度过难关。

sentences.en: Pence makes the claim that the administration has spared no expense to try to put businesses and workers back on their feet.
sentences.zh: 彭斯声称政府不惜一切代价试图让企业和工人恢复元气。

sentences.en: That is obviously not true based on what we've seen the last couple of days with the president blowing up talks on the Hill
sentences.zh: 根据我们过去几天看到的总统叫停国会谈判的情况，这显然不是事实，

sentences.en: for additional COVID economic relief to individuals and businesses.
sentences.zh: 那些谈判是为了给个人和企业提供额外的新冠经济救助。

sentences.en: But that is the claim that the vice president makes.
sentences.zh: 但这就是副总统所做的声明。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, I thought we saw enough of it in last week's debate, but I think this is supposed to be a debate based on fact and truth.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，我认为我们在上周的辩论中已经看够了，但我认为这应该是一场基于事实和真相的辩论。

sentences.en: And the truth and the fact is Joe Biden has been very clear.
sentences.zh: 真相和事实是乔·拜登已经说得很清楚了。

sentences.en: He will not raise taxes on anybody who makes less than $400,000 a year.
sentences.zh: 他不会对任何年收入低于40万美元的人加税。

sentences.en: He said he's going to repeal the Trump tax cuts.
sentences.zh: 他说他要废除特朗普的减税政策。

sentences.en: Mr. Vice President, I'm speaking.
sentences.zh: 副总统先生，我在发言。

sentences.en: Well, wait.
sentences.zh: 嗯，等等。

sentences.en: I'm speaking.
sentences.zh: 我在发言。

sentences.en: It would be important if you said the truth.
sentences.zh: 如果你说的是实话，那很重要。

sentences.en: Joe Biden has said twice in the debate last week that he's going to repeal the Trump tax cuts.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登在上周的辩论中两次说过他要废除特朗普的减税政策。

sentences.en: That was tax cuts that gave the average working family $2,000 in a tax break every single year.
sentences.zh: 那是减税政策，让普通工薪家庭每年能省下2000美元的税款。

sentences.en: Senator, that's the math.
sentences.zh: 参议员，这就是账面数字。

sentences.en: That is absolutely not true.
sentences.zh: 那绝对不是事实。

sentences.en: Democrats have made a very deliberate choice not to try to have a fight in this election about universal tax increases.
sentences.zh: 民主党人非常审慎地做出了选择，即不在这次选举中试图就全面增税问题进行争论。

sentences.en: Joe Biden has pledged over and over that he will not raise taxes on people making less than $400,000 a year.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登一再承诺，他不会对年收入低于40万美元的人增税。

sentences.en: So trying to really shift the argument about who should be paying more in the direction of people who are very affluent and big corporations.
sentences.zh: 所以，真正试图将争论焦点转移到谁应该多缴税的问题上，即针对那些非常富有的人和大公司。

sentences.en: That's how Joe Biden thinks about the economy, which is it's about investing in the people of our country as opposed to passing a tax bill,
sentences.zh: 这就是乔·拜登对经济的看法，即经济在于投资我们国家的人民，而不是通过一项税收法案，

sentences.en: which had the benefit of letting American corporations go offshore to do their business.
sentences.zh: 而该法案的好处是让美国公司可以去海外开展业务。

sentences.en: But they have both in the past expressed openness to broader tax increases and a full rollback of the Trump tax cuts.
sentences.zh: 但他们过去都曾表示愿意考虑更广泛的增税，并全面撤销特朗普的减税政策。

sentences.en: And that's the space that Pence really tries to go on the attack.
sentences.zh: 而这正是彭斯真正试图发起攻击的领域。

sentences.en: Is he only cutting, is he only going to repeal part of the Trump tax cuts?
sentences.zh: 他只是在削减，他只是要废除特朗普减税政策的一部分吗？

sentences.en: If you don't mind letting me finish, we can then have a conversation.
sentences.zh: 如果你不介意让我说完，我们之后可以再进行交流。

sentences.en: OK?
sentences.zh: 好吗？

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: 请。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: It's also where you see Senator Harris sort of turn these moments somewhat to, I think, her advantage in highlighting that the vice president is talking over her
sentences.zh: 这也是你看到哈里斯参议员在某种程度上将这些时刻转化为她优势的地方，我认为，她强调副总统在打断她说话，

sentences.en: and saying quite firmly, I'm still speaking.
sentences.zh: 并相当坚定地说：我还在发言。

sentences.en: I would like to finish.
sentences.zh: 我想把话说完。

sentences.en: It's the kind of line drawing that we did not see Joe Biden particularly attempt last week, let alone succeed in against a very different kind of adversary.
sentences.zh: 这种划清界限的方式，我们上周并没有看到乔·拜登特别尝试过，更不用说在面对一个截然不同的对手时取得成功了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能让你免费试用一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息，去探索《纽约时报》呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: Okay, so Alex, next up in the debate is climate change.
sentences.zh: 好的，亚历克斯，辩论的下一个议题是气候变化。

sentences.en: And Vice President Pence, I'd like to pose the first question to you.
sentences.zh: 彭斯副总统，我想把第一个问题提给你。

sentences.en: This year we've seen record-setting hurricanes in the South.
sentences.zh: 今年我们在南部看到了破纪录的飓风。

sentences.en: Another one, Hurricane Delta, is now threatening the Gulf.
sentences.zh: 另一个飓风，飓风“德尔塔”，现在正威胁着墨西哥湾沿岸。

sentences.en: It felt like that quickly became a set of appeals to swing states.
sentences.zh: 感觉这很快就变成了一系列针对摇摆州的诉求。

sentences.en: Do you believe, as the scientific community has concluded, that man-made climate change has made wildfires bigger, hotter, and more deadly, and have made hurricanes wetter, slower,
sentences.zh: 你是否相信，正如科学界所总结的那样，人为的气候变化使得野火规模更大、温度更高、更致命，并使飓风更潮湿、移动更缓慢，

sentences.en: and more damaging?
sentences.zh: 破坏力也更强？

sentences.en: You have two minutes uninterrupted.
sentences.zh: 你有两分钟的发言时间，不会被打断。

sentences.en: Thank you, Susan.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，苏珊。

sentences.en: Well, first, I'm very proud of our record on the environment and on conservation.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，我为我们在环境和保护方面的记录感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: This is just one of the most enormous gulfs between the two political parties, and between these two tickets in particular,
sentences.zh: 这只是两个政党之间，特别是这两组竞选搭档之间，最巨大的鸿沟之一，

sentences.en: that you have the Trump administration that has largely rejected climate science generally,
sentences.zh: 即特朗普政府在很大程度上普遍拒绝了气候科学，

sentences.en: and the specific policies that past administrations have developed to fight climate change,
sentences.zh: 以及过去政府为应对气候变化而制定的具体政策，

sentences.en: and the Democratic ticket, which is promising to put climate change at the front of their agenda.
sentences.zh: 而民主党竞选搭档则承诺将气候变化置于其议程的首位。

sentences.en: Now, with regard to climate change, the climate is changing, but the issue is, what's the cause, and what do we do about it?
sentences.zh: 现在，关于气候变化，气候确实在变化，但问题是，原因是什么，我们该怎么办？

sentences.en: President Trump has made it clear that we're going to continue to listen to the science.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统已经明确表示，我们将继续听取科学界的意见。

sentences.en: Mike Pence tries to take this global crisis of an issue, and he's asked.
sentences.zh: 迈克·彭斯试图抓住这个全球性危机议题，而他被问到了。

sentences.en: Vice President Pence, do you believe that climate change poses an existential threat?
sentences.zh: 彭斯副总统，你是否认为气候变化构成了生存威胁？

sentences.en: As I said, Susan, the climate is changing.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，苏珊，气候正在变化。

sentences.en: We'll follow the science.
sentences.zh: 我们将遵循科学。

sentences.en: And turn that vast issue into a much narrower subject, which is fracking.
sentences.zh: 并将那个宏大的议题转变为一个狭窄得多的主题，即水力压裂法。

sentences.en: But the both of you repeatedly committed to abolishing fossil fuel and banning fracking.
sentences.zh: 但你们两人都多次承诺要废除化石燃料并禁止水力压裂法。

sentences.en: And the development of certain kinds of energy resources in, specifically, the state of Pennsylvania and a couple other general election swing states.
sentences.zh: 以及在特定地区，特别是宾夕法尼亚州和其他几个大选摇摆州，开发某些类型的能源资源。

sentences.en: And this is a place where there is some political peril for the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 而这对民主党人来说确实存在一些政治风险。

sentences.en: And with regard to banning fracking, I just recommend that people look at the record.
sentences.zh: 关于禁止水力压裂法，我建议人们看看记录。

sentences.en: You yourself said repeatedly that you would ban fracking.
sentences.zh: 你自己多次说过你会禁止水力压裂法。

sentences.en: You were the first Senate co-sponsor of the Green New Deal.
sentences.zh: 你是“绿色新政”在参议院的第一位共同提案人。

sentences.en: That Senator Harris did say during the primary that she wants to get rid of fracking, that Joe Biden has said that over the long term he wants to get rid of fossil fuel.
sentences.zh: 哈里斯参议员在初选期间确实说过她想摆脱水力压裂法，乔·拜登也说过从长远来看他想摆脱化石燃料。

sentences.en: I don't know that it is the slam dunk issue that Vice President Pence imagines it to be in the context of a conversation on climate change.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这是否像彭斯副总统想象的那样，在气候变化的对话背景下是一个必胜的议题。

sentences.en: I think voters are very concerned about their own economic well-being.
sentences.zh: 我认为选民非常关心他们自己的经济福祉。

sentences.en: But we also see on a pretty convincing scale really acute concern about the implications of global warming,
sentences.zh: 但我们也看到，人们对全球变暖的影响有着相当深刻的担忧，这种担忧的规模非常令人信服，

sentences.en: the natural disasters it creates, the hardship that it will create in people's lives and their children and grandchildren's lives.
sentences.zh: 它所造成的自然灾害，以及它将给人们的生活、他们的子女和孙辈的生活带来的苦难。

sentences.en: And so when we see Pence take an issue of that size and narrow it down to essentially the size of central Pennsylvania,
sentences.zh: 所以，当我们看到彭斯把一个如此规模的问题缩小到基本上只有宾夕法尼亚州中部那么大时，

sentences.en: it does tell you something about the ground that he is and is not willing to fight on and the vulnerability that the administration has on the overarching issue.
sentences.zh: 这确实说明了他愿意和不愿意在哪些阵地上进行斗争，以及本届政府在这一总体问题上的脆弱性。

sentences.en: Well, I do want to talk more about the political risks to Democrats when it comes to fracking.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我确实想更多地谈谈民主党人在水力压裂法问题上所面临的政治风险。

sentences.en: Because during the primary, our colleague Shane Goldmucker reported here on the show that with Pennsylvania being such a key swing state
sentences.zh: 因为在初选期间，我们的同事谢恩·戈德穆克在节目中报道说，由于宾夕法尼亚州是一个如此关键的摇摆州，

sentences.en: and with many voters in Pennsylvania being so opposed to a ban on fracking, that if a Democratic candidate were to oppose fracking ever really,
sentences.zh: 而且许多宾夕法尼亚州的选民如此反对禁止水力压裂法，如果民主党候选人真的反对水力压裂法，

sentences.en: it would drive voters who might have otherwise supported that candidate to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 那将会把原本可能支持该候选人的选民推向唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: And so it seems like what you have here is Mike Pence being very aware of that reality and very aware of the polls in Pennsylvania and trying to convince Americans
sentences.zh: 所以看起来你在这里看到的是迈克·彭斯非常清楚这一现实，也非常清楚宾夕法尼亚州的民调，并试图说服美国人，

sentences.en: that Joe Biden and Kamala Harris are those kinds of Democrats.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登和卡玛拉·哈里斯就是那种类型的民主党人。

sentences.en: I think that's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 我认为你说得完全正确。

sentences.en: I think the context of the last week is important, that we saw Joe Biden after that first presidential debate take that train ride from northeast Ohio into central Pennsylvania
sentences.zh: 我认为上周的背景很重要，我们看到乔·拜登在第一次总统辩论后，乘坐火车从俄亥俄州东北部前往宾夕法尼亚州中部，

sentences.en: through a number of towns in Pennsylvania that are the kind of places that used to vote Democrat, voted Republican in 2016,
sentences.zh: 穿过了宾夕法尼亚州的许多城镇，这些地方曾经投票给民主党，但在2016年投票给了共和党，

sentences.en: and where Biden is trying to get back some of those working class, blue-collar, white voters, especially women without college degrees,
sentences.zh: 拜登正试图在那里争取回一些蓝领工薪阶层的白人选民，尤其是没有大学学位的女性，

sentences.en: and cut into President Trump's margin in more conservative parts of the state.
sentences.zh: 并削减特朗普总统在该州更保守地区的领先优势。

sentences.en: The fracking issue is the kind of thing Republicans turn to in those places to try to say, you know, whatever your reservations may be about President Trump.
sentences.zh: 水力压裂法问题是共和党人在这些地方用来试图说服选民的一种手段，你知道，无论你对特朗普总统有什么保留意见。

sentences.en: And however avuncular and charming you may find, Joe Biden, he's going to come and take your job.
sentences.zh: 而且无论你觉得乔·拜登多么和蔼可亲、富有魅力，他都会来抢走你的工作。

sentences.en: Well, we also heard Kamala Harris respond to this.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们也听到了卡玛拉·哈里斯对此的回应。

sentences.en: So first of all, I will repeat, and the American people know, that Joe Biden will not ban fracking.
sentences.zh: 所以首先，我要重申，美国人民都知道，乔·拜登不会禁止水力压裂法。

sentences.en: That is a fact.
sentences.zh: 这是一个事实。

sentences.en: Saying very, very clearly and over and over again, we will not ban fracking.
sentences.zh: 非常、非常清楚地一遍又一遍地说，我们不会禁止水力压裂法。

sentences.en: Joe Biden will not end fracking.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登不会终结水力压裂法。

sentences.en: He has been very clear about that.
sentences.zh: 他对此一直非常明确。

sentences.en: So it's not like she wasn't taking the political risk seriously, right?
sentences.zh: 所以并不是说她没有认真对待政治风险，对吧？

sentences.en: Not at all.
sentences.zh: 一点也不。

sentences.en: And I think one of the patterns that we saw throughout the debate was really a total willingness on the part of Senator Harris
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我们在整个辩论中看到的一种模式是，哈里斯参议员确实完全愿意，

sentences.en: to disavow the furthest left positions that she took during the Democratic primary.
sentences.zh: 否认她在民主党初选期间所采取的最左翼立场。

sentences.en: That's not necessarily abnormal.
sentences.zh: 这并不一定是不正常的。

sentences.en: The top of the ticket sets the agenda.
sentences.zh: 竞选搭档的领头人设定议程。

sentences.en: That's always the case.
sentences.zh: 情况总是这样。

sentences.en: And Joe Biden has always campaigned as a centriSt.
sentences.zh: 而且乔·拜登一直是以中间派的身份进行竞选的。

sentences.en: But I do think that it's an important signal about what kind of administration they would have and what kind of vice president she would be.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，这是一个重要的信号，表明他们会建立什么样的政府，以及她会成为什么样的副总统。

sentences.en: You didn't have a moment of, you know, Joe and I see this differently.
sentences.zh: 你没有看到那种，你知道，乔和我对此有不同看法的时候。

sentences.en: But, you know, his opinion is the one that matters right now.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，他的意见才是现在最重要的。

sentences.en: That she was very emphatic about trying to reassure voters in the middle that whatever the other folks may be saying about us, no, we're not these radical figures.
sentences.zh: 她非常强调试图让中间选民放心，无论其他人可能怎么说我们，不，我们不是那些激进的人物。

sentences.en: So, Alex, the debate then turns to the Supreme Court and a very pointed question that not for the first time in this debate does not get directly answered by either candidate.
sentences.zh: 所以，亚历克斯，辩论随后转向了最高法院，这是一个非常尖锐的问题，而且这并不是辩论中第一次没有得到任何候选人的直接回答。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The question goes first to Mike Pence.
sentences.zh: 这个问题首先抛给了迈克·彭斯。

sentences.en: Vice President Pence, you're the former governor of Indiana.
sentences.zh: 彭斯副总统，你是印第安纳州的前州长。

sentences.en: If Roe v.

sentences.en: And I don't care who in government is that they can stop us.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎政府里是谁，他们无法阻止我们。

sentences.en: They're wrong, but they're wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们错了，他们就是错了。

sentences.en: The protests were a response to new rules announced by Governor Andrew Cuomo that would severely limit how many people can gather at houses of worship in neighborhoods where the
sentences.zh: 这些抗议活动是对安德鲁·科莫州长宣布的新规定的回应，该规定将严格限制在疫情爆发的社区中，

sentences.en: outbreaks have emerged, many of which have large Jewish populations.

sentences.en: To the extent there are communities that are upset, that's because they haven't been following the original rules.

sentences.en: That's why the infections are being enforced.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么感染控制正在加强执行。

sentences.en: During a conference call, Cuomo defended the new rules and said that they would remain in place for at least two weeks.
sentences.zh: 在一次电话会议中，科莫为新规定进行了辩护，并表示这些规定将至少持续两周。

sentences.en: And, President Trump has returned to the Oval Office over the objections of aides who had
sentences.zh: 此外，特朗普总统在助手们的反对下回到了椭圆形办公室，

sentences.en: Aides who are expected to come into close contact with the president have been advised to wear personal protective equipment, including a gown and gloves.
